systems_changed.change_summary: Comeback souls are gutted across three levers: the flat forgiveness bonus for being slightly behind is removed, comeback bounties are trimmed, and Rift resist now scales from ~10% up to a 40% cap at 30m instead of a flat 35%. Extra comeback value is rerouted to the two lowest-net-worth players via tick gold rather than paid to whoever holds the lead.
driving_changes: Removed a fixed amount of extra bonus souls you would get for being behind even a very slightly amount in net worth
Slightly reduced comeback bounties in general
Unstable Rift comeback resist now 10% + 1% per minute, cap 40% at 30m (was flat 35%)
A portion of the comeback souls earned by players above enemy teams average net worth is instead distributed via tick gold to the lowest 2 players
systems_changed.effect_on_play: Losing lane is now a real, compounding deficit instead of a temporary one; the fed player can no longer be bailed out by a single kill, and early Unstable Rift fights become genuine contests rather than free resist-farming for the behind team. This is the single biggest swing in the patch.

systems_changed.change_summary: Guardian bounty +10%, Walker +5%, but the share that goes to heroes standing nearby drops 30%->25%, with the remainder spread to all six players. Objective value is up in total but less concentrated on the players who actually take it.
driving_changes: Share for objectives bounty to nearby heroes reduced from 30% to 25%
systems_changed.effect_on_play: Taking map objectives is worth more to the team as a whole, so coordinated pushes still pay, but the individual snowballer who solos a Guardian gets a smaller personal spike. Slightly flattens intra-team econ from objectives while raising the pie.

systems_changed.change_summary: Respawn at 20 minutes rises 35s->38s; the max later-game values are unchanged.
driving_changes: Respawn Time at 20 minutes increased from 35s to 38s
systems_changed.effect_on_play: A death in the mid-game costs marginally more map time, nudging the punishment for overextending in the tempo window. Small on its own.

systems_changed.change_summary: All move slows cut ~20% and ground-dash slows ~10%, but slows now also bite air drag at 35% of their value. Ground mobility gets smoother; flight gets punished by the same CC that used to ignore it.
driving_changes: All move slow values reduced by ~20% globally
All ground dash slows reduced by ~10% globally
Slows now also affect air drag by 35% of the slow value
systems_changed.effect_on_play: Ground kiting and escape get easier, so slows are a weaker lockdown tool in lane and skirmish; conversely flies become a liability, since any slow now drags them and chains into follow-up. Net shift of power off airborne heroes toward grounded mobile ones.

systems_changed.change_summary: Parry now pauses reload rather than restarting it, a dash can be cancelled into an on-the-spot parry, and stuns pause reload instead of resetting it.
driving_changes: Parrying while doing a regular dash will now cancel the dash (and momentum) and parry on the spot
Getting stunned now pauses your reload rather than restarting it
systems_changed.effect_on_play: Defensive tech is cheaper: you no longer lose reload progress to parry or to a stun, and the dash-cancel parry gives a reactive block/parry option that previously cost momentum and cycle time. Rewards precise, reactive play and raises the ceiling on duel-heavy interactions.

systems_changed.change_summary: Dashes and light melee no longer pause the gun's cycle time, so weaving movement or melee into a fight stops costing you shots.
driving_changes: Dashes and light melee's no longer pause your gun's cycle time
systems_changed.effect_on_play: Direct buff to shotgun/burst-cycle weapons and brawlers who attack while repositioning (high-cycle builds gain the most) and to melee-in-gun duels. Tightens the burst window for aggressive gun play, reinforcing the tempo direction.

systems_changed.change_summary: Underground tunnel breakables spawn later (3m->5m) and respawn slower (3m->5m).
driving_changes: Breakables in the underground tunnels initial spawn time increased from 3m to 5m
Breakables in the underground tunnels respawn rate increased from 3m to 5m
systems_changed.effect_on_play: Small hit to early jungle income from the tunnel route, mildly delaying the first farm spike and shifting value toward lane income and kills.

tempo_shift.why: Comeback souls are gutted on three fronts, rift resist no longer gifts the behind team, and the movement/reload/gun-cycle changes speed up aggressive dueling, so winning lane and snowballing now convert directly into the game rather than being refunded later.

archetype_effects.why: Comeback bounty removal plus Guardian +10% means winning lane now compounds instead of being refunded.
Dashes and light melee no longer pause gun cycle time, disproportionately helping high-cycle weapons (Silver, Abrams-style).
Gutted comeback souls and the scaling rift resist remove the safety net that let scalers absorb an early deficit.
Global slow reduction eases grounded escapes, and dash-cancel parry adds a cheap reactive option; tempo win-lane dynamics favor them.
Post-comeback-economy nerfs, casters that need to reach a spike are punished, and the gun-cycle change favors sustained gun damage over ability bursts in the tempo window.
Tank core items untouched and reload now pauses through stuns/parry, but no direct system buff lands here.
Slows now bite air drag at 35%, and airborne/poke heroes lose positioning safety while the game rewards early close-range aggression.
Objective bounties rise (Guardian +10%, Walker +5%) but the local 30%->25% share spreads value across the team, roughly offsetting for the individual pusher.
No systems change targets healing directly; the healing nerfs are item-side and not counted here.
Reactive dash-cancel parry and lower global slows make it easier to initiate into a fight without losing cycle time or reload.
Scaling-reliant spirit builds lose the comeback economy and the early rift safety net that bought them time to spike.

intent_read: Valve is closing the comeback valve so laning and early map pressure decide games, while softening combat feel (reload/parry no longer punish, gun cycle no longer pauses) to reward aggressive high-APM dueling. The air-drag slow adds a specific tax on airborne heroes, and the objective-share change spreads econ team-wide to blunt single-player snowball while keeping objectives worth fighting for.
